instruction: Put the red pen in the green pen case.

attempts.code:
candidates = grasp_candidates("red_pen")
best_candidate = None
for c in candidates:
    if c["source"] == "geometry" and abs(c["yaw"] - (1.107 + 0.5 * 3.1416)) < 0.1:  # fingers perpendicular to long axis
        if abs(c["height"] - 0.013) < 0.002:
            best_candidate = c
            break
if best_candidate is None:
    best_candidate = candidates[0]  # fallback

grasp_result = grasp(best_candidate)
if not grasp_result["holding_something"]:
    raise RuntimeError("Failed to grasp red_pen")

spots = free_spots("green_case", "red_pen")
if not spots:
    raise RuntimeError("No free spot in green_case")

spot = spots[0]
target_x, target_y = spot["x"], spot["y"]
target_yaw = spot["object_long_axis_yaw"]

carry_to(target_x, target_y, height=0.18, yaw=target_yaw)
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat()
check("red_pen", "green_case")
